def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    product_set = set(entity_ids)

    # --- История покупок строго до seed_time ---
    mask = order_items["product_id"].isin(product_set) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask, ["order_id", "product_id", "seller_id",
                                   "price", "freight_value", "ts"]].copy()

    if items.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        for c in [
            "order_count", "unique_orders", "unique_customers", "unique_sellers",
            "total_price", "avg_price", "std_price", "max_price", "min_price",
            "total_freight", "avg_freight",
            "cnt_30", "cnt_60", "cnt_90",
            "delivered_share", "delivered_share_ever",
            "avg_review", "std_review", "total_reviews",
            "avg_installments", "avg_payment_value", "paid_total",
            "credit_share", "debit_share", "voucher_share",
            "last_purchase_days", "first_purchase_days", "avg_daily_orders",
            "cnt_30_share", "avg_delay_approved", "delivered_avg_days",
        ]:
            result[c] = 0.0
        return result.reindex(entity_ids)

    # --- Заказы: берём только строки, существующие на seed_time ---
    orders_sub = orders[
        (orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status",
       "order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
       "order_delivered_customer_date"]].copy()

    # Флаги статусов, известные на момент seed_time:
    # "доставлен" знаем только если доставка уже произошла;
    # про отмену/недоставку ничего не утверждаем (дата отмены неизвестна).
    orders_sub["is_delivered"] = (
        (orders_sub["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna())
        & (orders_sub["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    ).astype(int)

    # Время одобрения оплаты (если известно на seed_time)
    orders_sub["approve_delay_days"] = (
        (orders_sub["order_approved_at"] - orders_sub["order_purchase_timestamp"])
        / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    )
    orders_sub.loc[
        orders_sub["order_approved_at"] > seed_time, "approve_delay_days"
    ] = np.nan
    # Если одобрения ещё не было — тоже неизвестно
    orders_sub.loc[orders_sub["order_approved_at"].isna(), "approve_delay_days"] = np.nan

    # Скорость доставки — только для фактически доставленных до seed_time
    orders_sub["delivered_days"] = (
        (orders_sub["order_delivered_customer_date"] - orders_sub["order_purchase_timestamp"])
        / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    )
    orders_sub.loc[orders_sub["is_delivered"] == 0, "delivered_days"] = np.nan

    items = items.merge(
        orders_sub[["order_id", "customer_id", "is_delivered",
                    "approve_delay_days", "delivered_days"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # --- Платежи: только по заказам, оплаченным до seed_time ---
    pay_ok = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay_ok.groupby("order_id").agg(
        install_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        total_pay=("payment_value", "sum"),
        credit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "credit_card").mean()),
        debit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "debit_card").mean()),
        voucher_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "voucher").mean()),
    )

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к моменту seed_time ---
    rev_ok = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev_ok.groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_id", "count"),
        rev_avg=("review_score", "mean"),
        rev_std=("review_score", "std"),
    )

    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- Окна активности ---
    items["cnt_30"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_60"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_90"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).astype(int)

    g = items.groupby("product_id")
    feat = g.agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "count"),
        unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        cnt_30=("cnt_30", "sum"),
        cnt_60=("cnt_60", "sum"),
        cnt_90=("cnt_90", "sum"),
        delivered_share=("is_delivered", "mean"),
        avg_review=("rev_avg", "mean"),
        std_review=("rev_std", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("rev_count", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("install_mean", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("total_pay", "mean"),
        paid_total=("total_pay", "sum"),
        credit_share=("credit_share", "mean"),
        debit_share=("debit_share", "mean"),
        voucher_share=("voucher_share", "mean"),
        max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        min_ts=("ts", "min"),
        approve_delay=("approve_delay_days", "mean"),
        delivered_days_avg=("delivered_days", "mean"),
    )

    # Доля доставленных среди заказов старше 90 дней (у них доставка уже должна была быть)
    old = items[items["ts"] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    if not old.empty:
        delivered_ever = old.groupby("product_id")["is_delivered"].mean()
    else:
        delivered_ever = pd.Series(dtype=float)
    feat["delivered_share_ever"] = delivered_ever

    # --- Временные признаки ---
    last_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["max_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    first_purchase_days = (seed_time - feat["min_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["last_purchase_days"] = last_purchase_days
    feat["first_purchase_days"] = first_purchase_days
    feat["avg_daily_orders"] = feat["order_count"] / first_purchase_days.clip(lower=1)
    feat["cnt_30_share"] = feat["cnt_30"] / feat["order_count"].clip(lower=1)

    feat = feat.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts"])

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    result = result.join(feat, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
